items.text: Located in a food desert, this project will establish a multi-purpose community center for the South End, offering a community gathering space alongside food, health, wellness, and small business support services.

This project will fund a "Community Campus" that enhances the lives of Mechanicville area residents by providing programming relating to food access, community education, mental and physical wellness, workforce development, and support for victims of domestic violence.
COMMUNITY PROJECT OF THE DAY: $1.2 million for Wastewater Treatment Plant upgrades in the Village of Altamont. https://t.co/SEaW8sjkdD

This project will fund improvements to Altamont's wastewater treatment plant, including the installation of a UV disinfection system and the addition of automated controls. 

These upgrades will safeguard the health of residents and preserve the water quality of the Bozen Kill.
